cues.text: Welcome to the acids and bases lab. Five unknown solutions are waiting on the bench. Start by choosing your indicators from the shelf at the back.
Good choice. Pick a test tube and predict the colour you expect. Then add the indicator and see if you were right.
Your indicator tests are done, so the pH paper is unlocked. Dip it into each tube and write down the exact pH.
Everything is recorded. When you are ready, submit your analysis to see what was really in each tube.
Here is what was really in the tubes. Compare it with your notebook, and look closely at any tube that surprised you.
